summary: Remote WebSocket agent grants server full-host shell, file, and self-upgrade control
details: The package runs as a persistent remote-worker agent. On startup it connects a WebSocket to a configurable server (default `ws://localhost:3456`, shared secret defaults to the literal string `agent-shared-secret`) and dispatches server-sent messages to handlers that spawn a PTY (`terminal_create` → `pty.spawn(shell,...)`), write attacker-supplied bytes into that PTY (`terminal_input` → `term.pty.write(msg.data)`), read and write arbitrary files, perform git operations, mutate MCP configuration, and self-upgrade via `npm install <pkgName>@latest` followed by a systemd/launchd/PM2 restart on an `upgrade_agent` message. Whoever controls the configured server has full-host code execution on the machine running the agent. The weak default authentication (loopback + hardcoded shared secret) further lowers the bar for any local process — or anything reachable on the configured port — to drive these handlers. Additionally, at every agent startup `index.js` runs `git clone` / `git pull --ff-only` of `https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git` (mutable HEAD, no commit pin) into `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/yeaft-skills-dev`, chmods hook scripts 0755, and enables the plugin in `~/.claude/settings.json`, so the current tip of that repository is loaded as a Claude Code plugin on each run.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
